description: Resolve a company name or website domain to its Jobo company ids. Prefix match on the name or the domain (2+ characters). Returns each company's ids, domain, HQ country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) and live job count, companies with live jobs first. Use it when the integration you are writing filters jobs by employer: store the ids, not the name, because a name also matches every other company called that. One company has one id per careers board, so put every id it returns into the `companies` filter (or `exclude_companies`). Needs the Jobo API key in this server's `Authorization: Bearer` header; a sandbox key (jbe_test_…) cannot use it. Free: rate limited, never billed.

q.description: Start of the company name or website domain, e.g. 'stripe' or 'stripe.com'.

name: find_companies
title: Find company ids
